bio.text: The Queens Daily Eagle described Pesach Osina in January 2026 as a longtime political staffer and former City Council candidate who launched a campaign for the 23rd Assembly District with the support of retiring Assemblymember Stacey Pheffer Amato.
According to the Eagle, he has worked in the City Council and the city comptroller's office and was an appointee of Mayor Eric Adams to the city Commission on Racial Equity.

sources.title: Osina launches campaign with Pheffer Amato's backing
